full_judgment: 5. In 6 D.L.R. 595 an application under section 174 of the Bengal Tenancy Act was allowed by the learned Munsif with costs on petitioners depositing the decretal amount together with statutory compensation by 11th August, 1951 in default the Misc. Case shall stand dismissed. On 11th August, 1951 the learned Munsif allowed the prayer of the petitioner for further extension of time upto 29th August, 1951 but on that date as well, the judgment debtor petitioner failed to deposit the amount and the case was dismissed. Subsequently the judgment debtor deposited the decretal amount on 8th September, 1951 which was not accepted by the Court. His lordship Akbar, J. as he then was held sitting singly:
